consistency_findings: The primary composite benefit and first HF-hospitalization component favor empagliflozin; cardiovascular mortality alone has a confidence interval spanning no effect and is retained separately.
Outcomes outside the hierarchical testing sequence are tagged as outside-hierarchy/nonconfirmatory rather than promoted to confirmatory findings.
The LVEF ≥60% subgroup point estimate favored empagliflozin but its 95% CI included 1.0; no subgroup interaction claim was inferred.
Safety event atoms preserve reported arm counts/percentages; no relative risks were calculated.
extraction_limitations: Model-extracted atoms are marked needs_review; no human verification was fabricated.
The 360-page protocol/SAP packet was semantically scoped to final protocol/TSAP versions and material analysis changes; duplicative operational content was not atomized.
Bibliography entries were routed to a separate task queue and were not treated as trial-generated evidence.
